summary: Pit-state handler fired once when the one-shot flag at this+0x180 is non-zero (the "exiting pits under red flag" condition). Notifies a state change to 0 via StateChangeNotify, clears the flag, increments the pit-exit counter in the vehicle's pit state at vehicle+0x406C, and calls AIFormationLap with the vehicle pointer. When the race-config gate dword_8ACFD4 equals 2 and penalties are enabled (dword_7CEF84), it either disqualifies (session type dword_7C56A4 == 7) or applies a time penalty via sub_4BBA90 with the aExitingPitsUnd message. Finally, if the sub-object pointer at this+0x14 is non-null, returns the result of the helper called on it; otherwise returns the trailing result value.
